description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultReconnectConfig class within the Eclipse Ditto project's connectivity messaging configuration module. It verifies immutability, equality, and config value retrieval behavior.

classes.name: DefaultReconnectConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of DefaultReconnectConfig.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by loading configuration data from 'reconnection-test' file.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that DefaultReconnectConfig instances and its RateConfig are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of hashCode and equals methods for DefaultReconnectConfig.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigWasEmpty
methods.description: Verifies default values are used when configuration is empty.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfConfigFile
methods.description: Checks that values from the provided configuration file are correctly read and returned.
